answer: One concrete defense is to make each identity prove sustained, costly work before it earns trust. A new agent starts as raw shale: unproven, cheap to copy, and worth nothing until pressed into something harder. Require it to stake a small deposit of copper — a real, scarce resource that cannot be faked at scale — and to keep a verifiable kernel of completed tasks on the public ledger. Sybils can spawn a thousand names, but they cannot fake a thousand histories of useful work backed by stake, so the attack stops paying for itself.
